cim: Epic Games will bet on artificial intelligence when transferring projects to Unreal Engine 6
cim_eredeti: Epic Games will bet on artificial intelligence when transferring projects to Unreal Engine 6
szoveg_eredeti:
Epic Games has officially confirmed a major architectural change. Unreal Engine 6, deciding to completely remove the Blueprints visual programming system ahead of the originally planned deadline. According to a statement from Executive Vice President of Development Markus Wassmer, the removal of this technology will affect even the version Unreal Engine 6 in Early Access, scheduled for release in late 2027. Along with Blueprints, the Actor Gameplay Framework will also be removed from the new engine. All game mechanics development will now be built exclusively on the Verse programming language and the new Scene Graph structure. Blueprints support will remain in effect. Unreal Engine 5.

Epic Games initially planned a gradual transition from version 5 of the engine, with old and new tools coexisting at the launch of version 6. However, the company is now relying on artificial intelligence tools to help developers automatically convert existing projects. As an example, Epic Games reported that it has already converted over 20,000 Fortnite Blueprints into approximately 3,000,000 lines of code in Verse. The results of this conversion are currently undergoing internal performance and memory consumption testing.

For many years, the Blueprints system has allowed developers, artists, and designers to create complex game mechanics without deep knowledge of classic programming. Epic Games is confident that artificial intelligence algorithms will simplify the transition to new standards and take over much of the routine work of code migration. However, replacing proven visual tools with automated solutions raises questions in the industry regarding engine accessibility, the level of control enjoyed by developers, and the ability of neural networks to consistently deliver quality comparable to established workflows.
